_about: Hand-kept list of past days scored against reality, shown on the website's How it works page. Plain language only. Details and full source lists: backtest_scorecard.md, 2026-10_king_tides.md. result: right | close | missed | false_alarm | pending. how: backtest (model run afterwards on the real measured tide + waves) | live (forecast saved before the event).

days.label: Sat Nov 14, 2026
days.title: Big surf at a high tide
days.happened: Waves splashed over the boardwalk wall about 11:00–11:45 am and water pooled on the boardwalk around San Rafael Pl and Santa Rita Pl, with shallow water on the nearby streets (not deep). The water level itself came in as forecast (6.31 ft measured vs 6.34 ft forecast); the waves were bigger than our main wave model said.
days.we_said: Saved the evening before: waves come close to the top of the boardwalk at a few spots (around San Rafael Pl and Santa Rita Pl) but no water flows over it.

sources.name: Eyewitness report + phone video, Brandon Sosa (project author)

days.note: Right place and time, but we under-called it: we said waves come close to the top, and water came over. Our higher wave model put these exact spots within 0.5 ft of the top. Fix in progress: check both wave models against measured buoys and correct for the low one.

days.label: Sat Nov 14, 2026
days.title: High tide on the bay side
days.happened: No bay water on Mission Beach streets; the sand berm along Bayside Walk held.
days.we_said: Saved the evening before: Mission Bay peaks near 6.5 ft around 11 am, far below the berm top, so no bay water on the streets.

sources.name: Eyewitness report + phone video, Brandon Sosa (project author)

days.label: Sat–Sun Nov 7–8, 2026
days.title: High tides after the berm was rebuilt
days.happened: No new flooding reported; the City had made the berm bigger.
days.we_said: Minor: the berm holds, but storm drains may back up into a few low streets.
days.note: Weak check: based on no reports of flooding.

days.label: Wed Oct 28, 2026
days.title: Briarfield Dr flooded
days.happened: Bay water covered E Briarfield Dr in Pacific Beach (Sail Bay).
days.we_said: The bay itself stays just short of this street (0.3 ft), but the ground nearby is lower than the water, so storm drains could back up. We flagged drain risk, not surface flooding.

days.label: Tue–Wed Oct 27–28, 2026
days.title: Rebuilt berm held
days.happened: The City's rebuilt sand berm held. Mission Beach stayed mostly dry, with some standing water in low streets and bike paths.
days.we_said: Minor: the berm holds the bay back, but storm drains may back up into low streets.

days.label: Mon Oct 26, 2026
days.title: Berm broke, streets flooded
days.happened: Mission Bay reached about 8.1 ft and the sand berm along Bayside Walk broke. Water flooded streets and homes from Belmont Park to the Catamaran, Mission Blvd at N Jetty Rd, and Pacific Beach Dr.
days.we_said: Minor while the berm holds, Major if it fails, with water reaching about 1,100 properties. It failed, and the flooded streets in the news match the ones on our map.

days.label: Oct 25–28, 2026
days.title: Record tides, small surf
days.happened: Surf was small (about 2–3 ft). No water came over the ocean boardwalk; all the flooding was on the bay side.
days.we_said: Ocean side: waves stay well below the top of the boardwalk.

days.label: Sun Oct 25, 2026
days.title: Very high tide, berm leaked
days.happened: Bay water pushed through the sand berm into Mission Beach yards and homes around 8:30 am; Dawes St in Pacific Beach flooded to Pacific Beach Dr.
days.we_said: Minor if the berm holds; Major if it fails.
days.note: The main rating trusted the berm. The 'if the berm fails' rating was right.

days.label: Sun Oct 11, 2026
days.title: Coastal flood warning
days.happened: A Pacific Beach neighborhood by the bay near Pacific Beach Dr flooded after the morning high tide.
days.we_said: Pacific Beach Minor: storm drains may back up into low streets.
days.note: Right place, but more water than 'Minor' suggests.

days.label: Tue Aug 11, 2026 (night)
days.title: Summer king tide
days.happened: Homes and cars around Mission Bay surrounded by water.
days.we_said: Minor if the berm holds; Major if it fails.
days.note: There is no berm in summer, so the 'if the berm fails' rating (Major) was the right one.

days.label: Tue Jul 14, 2026 (night)
days.title: Summer king tide
days.happened: Water came over both Mission Beach walkways, into alleys and underground garages. The City doesn't build sand berms in summer.
days.we_said: Minor if the berm holds; Major if it fails.
days.note: Same lesson: no summer berm, so 'if the berm fails' (Major) was right.

days.label: Sun Dec 22, 2024
days.title: Huge surf at a low tide
days.happened: Video of water washing onto the Mission Beach boardwalk; lifeguards reported 8–12 ft surf.
days.we_said: Low: the waves were huge but the tide was low, so they stop about 3 ft below the top.
days.note: Waves ran higher up the beach than our formula says, like on Nov 14, 2026.

days.label: Thu Jan 4, 2024
days.title: Huge swell at low tide
days.happened: A second big swell hit, but near low tide. No boardwalk flooding was reported.
days.we_said: Low: the big waves arrive when the tide is low, so they stop short of the boardwalk.

days.label: Dec 28–30, 2023
days.title: Boardwalk underwater
days.happened: Big surf and high tides put the boardwalk underwater in Mission Beach and Pacific Beach, with water in nearby streets and yards.
days.we_said: Mission Beach Moderate on Fri 29 and Major on Sat 30: waves wash over the boardwalk.
days.note: Reports don't say exactly which day was worst. If it was Thu 28, we were a day late.

days.label: Sat Jan 21, 2023
days.title: King tide, about 7 ft
days.happened: The marsh at Kendall-Frost was underwater; no street flooding was named.
days.we_said: Minor: storm drains may back up into a few low streets.
days.note: Weak check: based on no reports of street flooding.

days.label: Fri Jan 6, 2023
days.title: Boardwalk covered in seawater
days.happened: Waves at high tide covered the Mission Beach boardwalk in seawater.
days.we_said: Mission Beach Major: waves wash over the boardwalk in a few places, 6–8 am.

days.label: Thu–Fri Apr 9–10, 2020
days.title: Heavy rain at a night high tide
days.happened: Flash flooding near Mission Beach the next morning, with water above car tires (1.8 in of rain).
days.we_said: Mission Beach Moderate on Apr 9: rain during the high tide, low streets may pond.
days.note: Flagged the night before the report.

days.label: Thu Nov 29, 2018
days.title: Evening rain at a low tide
days.happened: Minor street flooding near Mission Bay.
days.note: Rain that floods streets without a high tide isn't modeled yet (planned: rain flooding for all of PB and La Jolla).
